changes.title: Pro transfer overage rises to $0.20 per GB
changes.what_changed: Starting December 1, 2026, Fast Data Transfer beyond the included 1 TB on the Pro plan costs $0.20 per GB, up from $0.15 per GB. Hobby and Enterprise are unchanged.
changes.affects: Pro projects exceeding the included 1 TB; your Node backend runs on Vercel Pro.
changes.action: Review Pro transfer usage and update the overage budget before December 1, 2026.

changes.title: Alias moves December 2; old snapshot shuts down January 14
changes.what_changed: The gpt-6-luna alias moves to gpt-6-luna-2026-10 on December 2, 2026. The deprecated gpt-6-luna-2026-03 snapshot shuts down on January 14, 2027; the recommended replacement is gpt-6-luna-2026-10.
changes.affects: Calls using gpt-6-luna or gpt-6-luna-2026-03; your chat completions use the alias.
changes.action: Run chat-completion regression tests against gpt-6-luna-2026-10 before the alias moves; replace any gpt-6-luna-2026-03 pins before January 14, 2027.

changes.title: Subscription Checkout rejects customer_creation=if_required on upgrade
changes.what_changed: In API version 2026-11-12.acacia, customer_creation no longer accepts if_required for Checkout Sessions in subscription mode; omit the parameter instead.
changes.affects: Subscription-mode Checkout Sessions when upgrading to 2026-11-12.acacia; your Checkout integration is potentially affected.

deadline.wording: when you upgrade your API version to 2026-11-12.acacia

changes.action: Check subscription Checkout Session creation in the Node backend, omit customer_creation instead of sending if_required, and test before upgrading the API version.

changes.title: Support bot needs migration to Responses API
changes.what_changed: The Assistants API is deprecated in favor of the Responses API. Shutdown is later in 2027, with at least 6 months' notice of the exact date.
changes.affects: Assistants API integrations; your support bot uses this API.
changes.action: Scope the support bot's migration to the Responses API and track the exact shutdown-date announcement; no calendar deadline has been supplied.

report_markdown:
**Platform changes** 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16
Vercel Pro transfer overage rises December 1; the gpt-6-luna alias moves December 2.

**Act now**
- **Vercel Fast Data Transfer: Pro overage increase** (Starting December 1, 2026). Beyond the included 1 TB, pricing rises from $0.15 per GB to $0.20 per GB. _Do:_ Review usage and update the overage budget. [source](https://vercel.com/changelog/fast-data-transfer-pricing-update-for-pro)
- **OpenAI API gpt-6-luna: alias and snapshot migration** (by December 2, 2026). The alias moves to gpt-6-luna-2026-10; gpt-6-luna-2026-03 shuts down January 14, 2027. _Do:_ Regression-test the replacement before the alias moves and remove old snapshot pins before shutdown. [source](https://platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations)

**Coming**
- **Stripe API Checkout: subscription parameter break** (when you upgrade your API version to 2026-11-12.acacia). Subscription-mode Sessions no longer accept customer_creation=if_required. _Do:_ Omit the parameter and test before upgrading. [source](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/acacia/2026-11-12/checkout-customer-creation)
- **OpenAI API Assistants API: deprecated** (later in 2027). Responses API is the replacement; OpenAI promises at least 6 months' notice of the exact shutdown date. _Do:_ Scope the support bot migration and monitor the date announcement. [source](https://platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations)

_Checked: Stripe API (changelog), OpenAI API (deprecations), Vercel (changelog), using supplied page substitutes. Unconfirmed: none. Unreachable: all three supplied source sites; no live requests made._
